LESSON: SAFETY IN

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: ENVIRON-
Topic 4.2: Safety In

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Safety In
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how to identify activities and environment, strangers games?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Safety In
2. give Kenyan examples of Safety In
3. practise a safe skill for Safety In

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Safety In

Teach
• Observe Safety In in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Safety In (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Safety In.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Safety In.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Safety In.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Safety In.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Safety In: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how to identify activities and environment, strangers games?
2. how to report identify environment, accidents strangers?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Safety In with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
